title: Vienna BioCenter Summer School
about: The Vienna BioCenter Summer School offers university students summer research training at the Vienna BioCenter; the Open Program starts 1 July 2027. Applicants submit an online form plus an offline PDF, with no application fee.
requirements: At least 2 full years of university study completed before 30 June 2027
Still enrolled at university when the program starts
Two-part application: online form plus an offline PDF uploaded before the deadline

upskill.name: Domain Applications of AI I
why: field "Life sciences" → objective "Healthcare: diagnostic imaging, drug discovery, genomics, clinical decision support"
research training at the Vienna BioCenter → objective "Scientific discovery: protein folding (AlphaFold), materials science, climate modelling"
